options.description: Allow packages by vendor prefix (repeatable)

options.description: Exclude paths matching glob (search, tests gaps, overview, health; repeatable)

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Use an existing coverage report (file or glob). On crap/volatility/kitchensink/tests gaps/type/viz build, 'auto' collects coverage. On overview, coverage is used if available but 'dotnet test' is never run.

options.name: --no-coverage
options.description: Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery; coverage-dependent output shows n/a (overview, health, crap, volatility, kitchensink, tests gaps, type, viz build)

options.name: --coverage-build
options.description: Where 'dotnet test' builds when coverage is collected: isolated (default; under the assay cache) or in-place (the repository's own output — reuses a build you already made). Overrides ASSAY_COVERAGE_BUILD (crap, volatility, kitchensink, tests gaps, tests summary, viz build)

options.name: --base
options.description: Git revision to diff against (viz build: its merge-base with HEAD is analyzed in a temporary worktree)

options.name: --data
options.description: viz build: also save the dataset JSON for 'viz summary'

options.name: --members
options.description: viz build: include full per-member detail in the page

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description: viz build: include individual compiler diagnostics

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: viz build: skip 'dotnet restore' of the base checkout

options.name: --review-url
options.description: viz summary: hosted page URL — every named type becomes a deep link

options.name: --all
options.description:
skills install: install every skill, opt-in ones included
--include-generated Include code-generated members in analysis (BuildRenderTree, [GeneratedCode], *.g.cs — excluded by default)

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include test-project types in analysis (crap, tests gaps, deps — excluded by default)

options.name: --changed
options.description: Derive subjects from the git working-tree diff against HEAD (tests for)

options.name: --since
options.description: Diff the working tree against a commit/branch/tag instead of HEAD (tests for; implies --changed)

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description:
Exclude test-project types from search results (search — included by default)
Exit codes:
0   Success
2   Findings threshold exceeded (kitchensink --fail-on)
64  Usage error (unknown option, bad value, or missing argument)
66  Solution or entity not found
70  Internal error

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the running binary's version and path
